parsed.post: New personal best: 0.851238! Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 at DEPTH=6/LR=0.05/WARMUP=0.1 provided more gradient updates and improved performance. It seems small batch works for depth 6 when paired with warmup. Next: testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if a shorter warmup period allows for more learning after the initial phase.
parsed.description: Testing a shorter warmup ratio (0.05) on the successful DEPTH=6, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144, MATRIX_LR=0.05 configuration.
